items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: they scheduled some for Lionel Hamilton that we wasn't on... Lionel worked his band and then he switched off and worked with that ballerina

ctx.x: they stayed in there too long. I see. Oh, back to Washington. Eureka was quite a success up there. What about those other bands up there? Did you hear Chris ball about it? Oh, yeah. Chris played on the set.

Well, in fact we all played on the same concert. But they had us on different times and different hours, and then they scheduled some concerts in the day for Chris that we wasn't on, and they scheduled some for Lionel Hamilton that we wasn't on.
Seems to me we went to hear Chris together one day, when you weren't working. Yeah. That's right.
